# Personal Website - Siddhartha Srinivasa

Clean, maintainable academic website built with [Jekyll](https://jekyllrb.com/) and [sslabdata](https://github.com/siddhss5/sslabdata).

**Live site:** https://goodrobot.ai

## Architecture Philosophy

**Single source of truth** for all data. **Auto-generated** output. **No duplication.**

```
├── lab.yaml                    # Profile, links, site config (EDIT THIS)
├── data/
│   ├── people.yaml            # Lab members (EDIT THIS)
│   ├── projects.yaml          # Projects (EDIT THIS)
│   ├── awards.yaml            # Awards & honors (EDIT THIS)
│   ├── press.yaml             # Press coverage (EDIT THIS)
│   └── pubs/                  # BibTeX files (EDIT THIS - submodule)
├── site/                      # Jekyll site
│   ├── _config.yml            # ← Auto-generated from lab.yaml
│   ├── _data/
│   │   ├── lab.yml            # ← Auto-generated by sslabdata
│   │   ├── videos.yml         # ← Auto-updated weekly from YouTube
│   │   ├── awards.yml         # ← Auto-copied from data/awards.yaml
│   │   └── press.yml          # ← Auto-copied from data/press.yaml
│   ├── _pages/                # Site content
│   └── _posts/YYYY/           # Blog posts (organized by year)
└── scripts/
    ├── sync_config.py         # Syncs config & data files
    └── generate_videos.py     # YouTube API → videos.yml (weekly)
```

## Quick Start

```bash
# Install dependencies (sslabdata needs Python 3.10+)
bundle install --gemfile=site/Gemfile
uv pip install sslabdata

# Generate & serve
python scripts/sync_config.py
sslabdata --config lab.yaml --output site/_data/lab.yml
cd site && bundle exec jekyll serve

# Visit http://localhost:4000
```

Check the inputs without writing output: `sslabdata --config lab.yaml --validate`
(unmatched author names: `--unresolved`).

`lab.yaml`, `data/people.yaml` and `data/projects.yaml` each name their JSON
Schema on the first line, so an editor running the YAML language server (the
VS Code YAML extension, among others) checks and completes them as you type.
The schemas are served from sslabdata's `input-schema-v1` tag, which never
moves.

## Editing Content

### Profile & Links
**Edit:** `lab.yaml` (name, description, email, social links)
**Sync:** `python scripts/sync_config.py` (or let CI/CD do it)

### Publications
**Edit:** Add/update BibTeX in `data/pubs/*.bib`
**Build:** Automatic (sslabdata emits data; `site/_includes/publication.html` renders it)

### People (Students/Postdocs/Alumni)
**Edit:** `data/people.yaml`
**Build:** Automatic (sslabdata generates site data)

### Projects
**Edit:** `data/projects.yaml`
**Build:** Automatic (sslabdata links publications via the `project` BibTeX field)

### Awards & Honors
**Edit:** `data/awards.yaml`
**Build:** Automatic (copied to site/_data/)

### Press Coverage
**Edit:** `data/press.yaml`
**Build:** Automatic (copied to site/_data/)

### Blog Posts
**Create:** `site/_posts/YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD-title.md`
**Categories:** Use hyphens (`academic-advice`, not `Academic advice`)

### Videos
**Auto-updated:** Weekly via GitHub Actions
**Manual:** `python scripts/generate_videos.py`

## Deployment

Push to `main` or `minimal-mistakes` triggers:
1. `sync_config.py` - Sync config & copy data files (lab.yaml → _config.yml, data/*.yaml → site/_data/)
2. `sslabdata` - Create site/_data/lab.yml (schema v5 document)
3. `jekyll build` - Generate static site
4. Deploy to GitHub Pages

## Clean Architecture Guarantees

✅ **One source** - Edit data once, use everywhere
✅ **Auto-generated** - No manual HTML/YAML updates
✅ **Validated** - `sslabdata --validate` checks every input
✅ **No duplication** - DRY principle enforced
✅ **Automated** - CI/CD handles everything

## Tech Stack

- **Jekyll** - Static site generator
- **sslabdata** - Academic lab data assembler (BibTeX + YAML → structured data)
- **Minimal Mistakes** - Jekyll theme
- **GitHub Actions** - CI/CD
- **YouTube Data API** - Video integration
